narrative: A part on the desk, the Duke's name at the head, nothing copied under it. Daylight. No face. The same heading. No cue written beneath it. The pen is capped.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the heading on the part and did not write a line under it.

entities.name: The Two Gentlemen of Verona
entities.context: Shown on part in The Duke's name
